name: Onaping Lake
blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from a 1974 MNRF transect survey (year from the LIO bathymetry index; contour feature dates are null in LIO). No depth soundings exist for this lake - depths are interpolated between the survey contours and capped at 54.9 m; confidence is strictly distance-to-contour (83.4% of water cells at >=0.4). Cold-regime lake; lake trout, cisco, walleye in the ARA community. Muskellunge confirmed (ARA). Secchi 5 m (ARA).
